fusions.name: Split Spike
fusions.desc: Fires an iron spike that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 60% of that damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Two-Tine Rap
fusions.desc: Jabs with a two-pronged iron head, dealing 4 damage, making the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Both Ways Braced
fusions.desc: 25% of the damage that reaches you is split off your plate and sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Glancing Branch
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, the blow forks off your iron plate as lightning and deals 6 damage to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. Once every 3 seconds.
